title: Camera frames: delay and the attitude at the exposure (recorded clip)
summary: A picture is a measurement of one instant, and it is not 'now'. You write NAVERA Lite's timing part: frame-rate and jitter statistics, a camera's delay measured with screen flashes, what a time error costs on the ground, the attitude at each frame's exposure with slerp, and the rules that refuse untrustworthy frames — then run the camera node over ROS on a recorded clip. No camera needed.
